aiInterview.prompt:
You are an expert recruiter in talent acquisition.
You are evaluating a candidate for the position of: "{title}".
Here is the question you asked the candidate: "{question}"

Here is the transcript of the candidate's response:
"{transcript}"

Your task:
1. Evaluate the relevance of the response (Score out of 100).
2. Provide clear and constructive feedback as a recruiter (Was the response clear, vague, off-topic?).
3. If the response lacks detail, suggest a follow-up question you would ask.

Respond strictly in JSON format with this structure:
{
  "score": 85,
  "feedback": "The response is relevant but lacks concrete examples...",
  "followUpQuestion": "Can you give me an example of a project where you used this skill?",
  "isAnswerSatisfactory": true
}

posture.title2: What recruiters are truly looking for
posture.desc: On Netacuv, your resume is only the first step. The AI video interview is your genuine showcase. Confident posture and clear communication reassure employers and multiply your chances of landing the job.
posture.point1Desc: Look straight into the camera lens and speak clearly with a steady voice. It is the immediate indicator of your natural leadership.
posture.point2Desc: Recruiters seek real personalities, not robots. Be yourself and avoid reading prepared scripts verbatim.
posture.point3Desc: A neat background, great lighting on your face, and absence of background noise reflect your professionalism.

items.q: How does the AI video interview work?
items.a: Our AI asks tailored questions based on your field. It then analyzes your responses, fluency, body posture, and relevance to certify your skills directly in your browser or phone.

items.q: What are the limitations of the free plan?
items.a: Talents can apply to 1 job offer for free (lifetime limit). A Premium account is required for unlimited applications. Recruiters can set up their company profile and publish 1 job offer for free, but candidates' full contact details remain masked.

items.q: What benefits do recruiters get with the Premium plan?
items.a: Premium recruiters enjoy unlimited job postings, unrestricted candidate access (emails, phones, downloadable PDF resumes, full AI interview recordings), priority access to top-rated profiles, and advanced search filters.

items.q: How does the referral/affiliation program work?
items.a: Whether on Free or Premium plans, you earn cash rewards by inviting peers. Whenever someone registers through your link and upgrades to Premium, you earn an instant reward bonus!

items.q: How do recruiters get in touch with talents?
items.a: With a Premium subscription, recruiters gain instant direct access to candidates' emails, phone numbers, and social networks, alongside downloadable PDF resumes.

items.q: How does the AI evaluate candidate competencies?
items.a: Our AI evaluates both content (relevance, vocabulary) and non-verbal cues (posture, confidence, vocal clarity) to deliver an objective skill score and badge recognition.

items.q: Are transactions secure and what payment methods are accepted?
items.a: Yes, 100% secure. We accept African mobile money services (Orange Money, MTN MoMo, Moov Money) as well as international debit/credit cards via certified payment processors.

items.q: What are the perks of the Premium plan for a talent?
items.a: Premium talents can submit unlimited job applications, stand out with a verified Premium badge, take certified AI video interviews, and receive maximum recruiter exposure.
